title.zh-CN: 多年反复发热与进行性神经功能受损
title.en: Years of recurrent fever and progressive neurological impairment

summary.zh-CN: 女孩长期反复发热、肝脾肿大，神经症状逐步加重，需把多年检查按时间重新整合。
summary.en: A girl has recurrent fever, hepatosplenomegaly and worsening neurological symptoms, requiring chronological integration of years of records.

provenance.citation: 王玥, 薛露, 马翠, 李春怀. 慢性活动性EB病毒感染并发中枢神经系统EB病毒相关的T淋巴细胞增生性疾病一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(10):797-800. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.10.020.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: 2023 updated CAEBV guideline, checked 2026-10-28; scope EBV-infected T/NK-cell confirmation, viral load and specialist definitive-treatment assessment.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

question.zh-CN: 最初发病时有哪些表现？
question.en: What happened at the original onset?

answer.zh-CN: 约三岁半时发热、咽痛、一过眼睑水肿，继而躯干瘙痒性丘疹，发热反复。
answer.en: At about three and a half years, fever, sore throat and transient eyelid swelling were followed by an itchy truncal rash and recurrent fever.

question.zh-CN: 神经症状怎样出现和变化？

answer.zh-CN: 先左眼看不清，后来口角歪斜、走路不稳、反复凝视发作，语言思维和动作越来越慢。
answer.en: Left visual loss came first, then facial asymmetry, unsteadiness, recurrent staring episodes and increasingly slow speech, thought and movement.

question.zh-CN: 以前怎样解释这些症状？

answer.zh-CN: 曾按传染性单核细胞增多症、病毒性脑炎和急性播散性脑炎处理，症状一度缓解又反复。
answer.en: Previous labels included mononucleosis, viral encephalitis and acute disseminated encephalitis, with temporary improvement and recurrence.

name.zh-CN: 多年全身和神经检查摘要

zh-CN: 多年全身和神经检查摘要

text.zh-CN: 反复异形淋巴细胞10%–19%、血小板约103–117×10^9/L。后期血清及脑组织EBV DNA阳性；MRI白质多灶病变。脑脊液曾蛋白升高并有寡克隆带；未提供标准化全血病毒定量。
text.en: Atypical lymphocytes repeatedly 10%–19% and platelets approximately 103–117×10^9/L. Later serum and brain tissue EBV DNA were positive with multifocal white-matter MRI lesions. CSF protein elevation and oligoclonal bands were recorded; standardised whole-blood viral load was not supplied.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。
source.en: Adapted from the source case record; dialogue is a de-identified educational paraphrase.

note.zh-CN: 调阅原报告已完成的检查；不在实景模式中重新施行检查。
note.en: Review of an investigation already completed in the source; it is not repeated in in-world mode.

text.zh-CN: 小血管周围套袖样淋巴细胞聚集，CD45RO强阳性，以T细胞为主；脑组织EBV PCR阳性。未提供EBER与细胞谱系共定位或分选细胞病毒检测。多处取样未见噬血细胞。
text.en: Perivascular cuff-like lymphocytic aggregates were predominantly CD45RO-positive T cells; brain-tissue EBV PCR was positive. EBER-lineage colocalisation or sorted-cell viral testing was not provided. Haemophagocytes were not seen in sampled tissues.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。
source.en: Adapted from the source case record; dialogue is a de-identified educational paraphrase.

note.zh-CN: 调阅原报告已完成的检查；不在实景模式中重新施行检查。
note.en: Review of an investigation already completed in the source; it is not repeated in in-world mode.

text.zh-CN: 原报告改良方案后一度稳定23个月，但神经损害未明显改善；后复发、难治癫痫、颅内出血和高颅压，后续方案未控制，放弃治疗后约三个月死亡。
text.en: The historical modified regimen produced 23 months of stability without clear neurological recovery; relapse, refractory seizures, intracranial bleeding and raised pressure followed. Later treatment failed and death occurred about three months after care was withdrawn.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。
source.en: Adapted from the source case record; dialogue is a de-identified educational paraphrase.

hint.en: Identify localising signs and retain missing information as unknown.

hint.en: Place findings in their timeline and compare explanations for the complete evidence.

title.en: Plan care and review the outcome

hint.en: Distinguish reported care from the educational plan and review subsequent changes.

guidance.en: Plan care and review the outcome

prompt.zh-CN: 多年全身和中枢表现如何归纳？
prompt.en: How should years of systemic and CNS findings be framed?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 需评估持续EBV相关系统病及淋巴增殖过程，不能仅用单次自限脑炎解释
text.en: Assess persistent EBV-associated systemic disease and a lymphoproliferative process rather than a single self-limited encephalitis

feedback.zh-CN: 长期发热、肝脾肿大和病毒证据要求扩大评估。
feedback.en: Longstanding fever, organomegaly and viral evidence warrant broader assessment.

text.zh-CN: 寡克隆带阳性就足以归为单纯多发性硬化
text.en: Positive oligoclonal bands alone establish isolated multiple sclerosis

feedback.zh-CN: 无法完整解释明显全身和病毒相关表现。
feedback.en: This does not explain the systemic and viral findings.

text.zh-CN: 病程五年仍可直接按一次急性感染处理
text.en: Five years of illness can be treated as one uncomplicated acute infection

feedback.zh-CN: 反复和进展需要重审病因。

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 原报告支持CAEBV及T细胞相关过程，但组织PCR加T细胞浸润并不直接证明感染细胞谱系
text.en: The report supports CAEBV and a T-cell-associated process, but tissue PCR plus T-cell infiltration does not directly establish the infected lineage

feedback.zh-CN: 现代诊断需要更具体的EBV感染细胞证据，未给资料不能补写。
feedback.en: Modern diagnosis requires more specific evidence of infected cells; missing data cannot be invented.

text.zh-CN: 没看见噬血细胞就永久排除HLH
text.en: Absent haemophagocytes permanently exclude HLH

feedback.zh-CN: 单项形态阴性不能替代完整综合标准。
feedback.en: Negative morphology alone does not replace the full syndrome assessment.

text.zh-CN: 已经有EBER/T细胞双染阳性证明
text.en: EBER/T-cell double staining is proven positive

feedback.en: The source did not provide that test.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前专科路径应如何规划？
prompt.en: How should a current specialist pathway be planned?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 血液、感染和神经团队完善病毒定量与感染细胞分型，评估根本治疗及中枢支持
text.en: Haematology, infection and neurology teams should refine viral quantification and infected-cell typing and assess definitive therapy plus CNS support

feedback.zh-CN: 2023指南强调完整诊断与专科治疗；不能把旧抗病毒或B细胞靶向疗程泛化。
feedback.en: The 2023 guideline emphasises complete diagnosis and specialist treatment; historical antiviral or B-cell-targeted courses cannot be generalised.

text.zh-CN: 所有T细胞相关病都按旧文重复利妥昔单抗
text.en: Repeat historical rituximab for every T-cell-associated disease

feedback.zh-CN: 药物靶点与感染细胞谱系必须核对。
feedback.en: Drug target and infected-cell lineage require reconciliation.

text.zh-CN: 短期退热证明单纯抗病毒已根治
text.en: Temporary defervescence proves cure by antiviral treatment alone

feedback.zh-CN: 症状暂缓不证明异常细胞过程清除。
feedback.en: Temporary symptom control does not establish eradication of the abnormal cellular process.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 明确感染细胞谱系并综合评估HLH与中枢风险，不以单项阴性或旧方案定案
text.en: Establish infected-cell lineage and assess HLH/CNS risk without relying on one negative test or historical regimen

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明长病程与系统受累反对单次局限脑炎。；承认缺少标准化病毒定量、感染细胞共定位、完整HLH评估及移植评估。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Long course and systemic disease argue against one isolated encephalitis.; acknowledge Standardised viral load, infected-cell colocalisation, complete HLH evaluation and transplant assessment are absent. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原文诊断慢性活动性EBV感染伴中枢T淋巴细胞增殖性疾病，现代感染细胞谱系确认仍缺失。
conclusion.en: The source diagnosed chronic active EBV infection with CNS T-lymphoproliferative disease, while modern infected-lineage confirmation remains missing.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 长病程与系统受累反对单次局限脑炎。
keyReasoning.en: Long course and systemic disease argue against one isolated encephalitis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: PCR和细胞表型需证明在同一细胞层面关联。
keyReasoning.en: PCR and cell phenotype need linkage at the infected-cell level.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 形态未见噬血不等于排除综合征。
keyReasoning.en: Absent haemophagocytosis does not exclude the syndrome.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 旧文早期急性EBV因果并未完整确证。
teachingPoints.en: Early acute EBV causality was not fully established in the old record.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不同年代检查阈值不能直接混用。
teachingPoints.en: Testing thresholds from different eras are not interchangeable.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 无长期改善不意味着所有现代方法无效。
teachingPoints.en: Historical poor recovery does not establish futility of all modern care.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
